notes.title: KEY REBIND UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/408ad718f49934aae32d3511111667412b99df93.png
Hi everyone!

Finally some news. First of all, thanks again for all your enthusiasm for the game, all the screenshots you've posted, all the incredible theories and fantastic reviews. It's been a real joy to share this project with you.

On the good news front, today's update includes:

- A rebind menu for joystick and keyboard controls

- An optimisation pass to reduce CPU VRAM saturation

- A few tweaks here and there in the level art to fix some imperfections.


This last point is a bit behind schedule, and I've still got a few things to do, because we spent a lot of time on this   ***"#$£§(//***"!!@  of a crash.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/13116e762d91efdab87e7a88f21ef4a62e8cce1d.png

That's where it gets complicated. We've done a lot of invisible things to solve the problem, from tweaking, of course, to magic tricks to get through the save loading without crashing. We've tested a lot of solutions that work for some people. Your feedback has helped us more than you can imagine, but the problem seems to persist in certain cases.

We were going to wait a little longer before releasing this patch, but time is passing and we're no longer seeing crashes from the majority of our testers, so we think it's the right time to release this patch and see how effective it is on a large scale.


There's still a lot of uncertainty, I won't deny it. We're still testing, we're still looking, we're still relying on tweaks to reduce the occurrence. We're pretty convinced that Nvidia graphics card drivers, even the latest ones, are interfering with a bunch of processes, as we've found that other games developed with Unreal are suffering from this kind of problem.

The only thing we can do is continue to refine everything on our side, step by step. It's very frustrating and very depressing, I have to admit. But that's the way it is.

We're doing our best and apologize in advance to those who won't see their problems solved by this update, because there will undoubtedly be some. You're not forgotten.

I don't want to get ahead of myself about the next content, but you should know that things are moving  forward! We're trying to be much more careful in the future.

We will talk again very soon.

Until then, take care.


NOTE :

It seems that screens larger than 2560x1440 are very problematic, and at the moment playing with directx11 is the most practical solution, even if it disables the ray tracing software and thus the global illumination that is a big part of the game's beauty. For now, we recommend not exceeding this resolution.

We've just added a launcher that lets you choose to play the game in dx11 or dx12 at launch.

notes.title: HOTFIX 5 : Settings
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



Thank you for your feedback on the new options menus, for all the new reviews that have been posted in the meantime, and for everyone joining Discord and getting involved. You people are awesome.



Today's update: 

- FOV reset after using witnesses, loading, interactions: fixed 

- Vsync reset after respawn: fixed 

- Incomplete menu translations after language change if game is not restarted: fixed 

- We added a message about the Unreal crash at startup (for the simplest and most common solution only) 



Ornicar (Discord name) is currently working on the key rebinding menu and some other customization options. 

I am reworking and fixing some small details/weaknesses in the level art that break immersion in remote (or not) locations, as well as making some improvements to the sound loops and another optimization pass. 

And there are surprises in store. Free additional content incoming, because you are all very supportive and that gives us ideas, inspiration and strength.

I won't say more yet, but there will be a little treasure hunt with familiar elements (area?) and some new ones. 


Until then, take care!

notes.title: GRAPHIC SETTINGS & ACCESSIBILITY UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/9ca6d76507ea5b476d472114d29c9f1595510f9a.png

Hi everyone! 

The big day has come, the full Graphics Settings and Accessibility menus are finally here! 
Here are some screenshots of what you can use from now on in the game. Thanks for your patience. We hope that more people will be able to access the game and enjoy it in the best conditions possible! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/29bba07d9c02757d9a977d759bb1a92976c66683.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/4cab0e55da0439f2731d5f5a861533233ca01a8a.jpg

Regarding the Unreal Crash, it's a hard one, investigation still in progress. We are left, for now, with these three interchangeable and/or complementary solutions: 
• Update the graphics card drivers

• Reinstalling the game seems to be enough and does not lose the savegame (tested and approved in yesterday's stream)

• Try Directx11 / 12, a bit more technical and less comfortable for the game's performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/910441965a4a87236d0940f28f6e6c3dd0d8dfcf.png

The jump section on pyramidal plateforms at the edge of the Convergence Zone has been completely reworked! It was too difficult, too poorly lit and deceptive in relation to what I wanted, and frustrated a lot of people. It's fixed! 

The full BLACKSHARD OST composed by ALT236 and AL9000 is now available everywhere! Spotify, Deezer, Bandcamp etc! You can listen to it, buy it, listen to it again and share it, we are really happy about it and this collaboration has been a blast for us. A vinyl is in the works at Frozen Records, we'll talk about it soon. 

https://alt236.bandcamp.com/album/blackshard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/43b3a054986ab8c37ab89337f1c6eb745dfecaa5.png

Next, we're working on a full key rebind menu. Our dear ultra-tech Dev will be travelling from tomorrow to visit me in France before we head back to his home in Hungary together. I'll be there for a month, in his place in the countryside, so the work and creative emulation will be at their peak! We will complete the purely technical work on BLACKSHARD together, and then it will be time to tell you what we have planned for the future of the game and of the ENCLAVE collective. 

I would like to take this opportunity to wave at the people who have (rightfully) posted negative reviews solely regarding the lack of graphics options, FOV, motion sickness, etc. If this major update addresses your concerns so you can finally play and enjoy the game, please consider supporting us by changing your review! We are fighting the Steam algorithm like all indies, every little gesture is welcome and helps us promote the game and look to the future. 

And for everyone else, that's fine too! A comment with a smiley is already a nice gift <3. We love reading your reviews, they are really groovy, poetic even for some. Thanks, a lot.

We'll also continue to post webcomics on the Enclave website : 

https://encl4ve.tumblr.com/


Until the next news, take care.

notes.title: CARCOSA Update
notes.notes:
“I cannot forget Carcosa where black stars hang in the heavens; where the shadows of men's thoughts lengthen in the afternoon, when the twin suns sink into the lake of Hali; and my mind will bear for ever the memory of the Pallid Mask. 

I pray God will curse the writer, as the writer has cursed the world with this beautiful, stupendous creation, terrible in its simplicity, irresistible in its truth—a world which now trembles before the King in Yellow.”


― Robert W. Chambers, The King in Yellow


; We Wait ; in the Promised Carcosa ;



* Still working hard on the graphic and accessibility options menu! In the meantime, things have changed in various places.*

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
As promised, a hotfix! 


- Correction on glitching textures in various levels
- Addition of a Witness in the lower area of the Tesseract, at the foot of a return path
- Correction of the teleportation box to the Organon
- Change in the passage between the Organon and the Crossroads: A state before and after the 'change' + some additions of walkable structures there
- Various adjustments to decals that were drooling on certain surfaces
- Fixes to some French translations 

I've also added witnesses in the Black Tower, and... reworked the lower area, 'cause I wasn't really satisfied as I saw you exploring it. I hope you will like it. 


Otherwise, the great work on accessibility and graphic options is going well :).
 Thanks to the brave players who found the DirectX11 fix, I have pinned it. You are heroes.


I wanted to say something else, but I forgot. 
If I remember, I'll talk about it soon.


Stay safe!
